HSET books:good title 'Good Book' year 1950
HSET books:bad title 'Bad Book' year 1930
HSET books:ok title 'Ok Book' year 1940

ZADD books:likes 900 good 
ZADD books:likes 0  bad 
ZADD books:likes 40 ok

//el simbolo * es para que recorra todo el sorted set

SORT books:likes by books:*->year

//el # nos sirve para insertar lo que fuera el miembro original

SORT books:likes by books:*->year 
    get #
    get books:*->title
    get books:*->year

//el nosort significa que no se haga una operacion de sort 

SORT books:likes by nosort desc
    get #
    get books:*->title
    get books:*->year


HSET key field_value 
ZADD key score_member
